meta.name: detecting-dcsync-attack-in-active-directory
meta.description: Detect DCSync attacks where adversaries abuse Active Directory replication privileges to extract password hashes by monitoring for non-domain-controller accounts requesting directory replication via DsGetNCChanges.

copy.tagline: 监控非域控账户的目录复制请求，及时发现密码哈希窃取攻击
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责企业AD安全，需要检测DCSync攻击
copy.tagline_en: Monitor directory replication requests from non-DC accounts to detect password hash theft
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage enterprise AD security and need to detect DCSync attacks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会指导你监控 Active Directory 中的 DCSync 攻击，通过分析事件 ID 4662 来检测非域控制器账户请求目录复制的行为。
howto.when: 当你在 Active Directory 环境中进行威胁狩猎、调查凭据窃取或响应涉及域管理员凭据的横向移动时触发。

say.text: 帮我检测最近是否有非域控制器账户请求了目录复制权限。
say.note: Claude 会分析事件日志并返回检测结果。

say.text: 检查域控制器上事件 ID 4662 中是否出现可疑的复制 GUID。
say.note: Claude 会提供查询语句并解释结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you to monitor for DCSync attacks in Active Directory by analyzing Event ID 4662 to detect non-domain-controller accounts requesting directory replication.
howto.when_en: Triggered when threat hunting in Active Directory, investigating credential theft, or responding to lateral movement with domain admin credentials.

say_en.text: Check if any non-DC account recently requested directory replication rights.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes event logs and returns detection results.

say_en.text: Look for suspicious replication GUIDs in Event ID 4662 on domain controllers.
say_en.note: Claude provides query and explains findings.
